signatureAbility.signatureDescription: The most tenacious defenders beat their blocks by sheer force of will. When they enter the zone, their rush move attempts are free.
Pass rushers with this ability are granted an additional maximum pass rush move point
Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting speed pass rush moves
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Defenders with this ability apply bonus fatigue to their man coverage target after a successful press win
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability do not need to spend a point on shed attempts during a run play
